_curatorNotes: High plunge frames exist in gcsim (highPlungeFrames in plunge.go) but lowPlungeFrames used per recipe convention. High plunge frames omitted.

N1: ActionCharge (C) defaults to AnimationLength=32 (not explicitly set in gcsim); omitted. N2: ActionAttack (N) and ActionCharge (C) both at AnimLen=33; omitted. N4: ActionCharge set to 500 in gcsim with comment 'TODO: this action is illegal; need better way to handle it' — omitted.

Charged-attack element-application ICD: gcsim charge.go tags it ICDTagExtraAttack / ICDGroupPoleExtraAttack, whose reset timer is 30f (0.5s) with only the first hit of each window applying (pkg/core/attacks/icd_groups.dm.go). Authored as chargedIcdWindow rather than a weapon-type rule in resolveActionIcd: the census is 16 of 19 oracled polearm users, and Xiao, Raiden and Emilie sit on the default. Reachable only while the swing is infused - bare, a polearm charged attack is Physical and applies nothing.

abilities.name: Sacred Rite: Heron's Sanctum

variants.label: Hold
_curatorNotes: input:['hE'] — the Hold variant is selected by the hE token; without it the variant was unreachable and hE fell back to base (Tap) timing/frames/shield. Fixed 2026-07-15; removed the redundant input-less 'Press' variant (its cooldown 6 = base, so Tap resolves off the base ability). Same unreachable-Hold-variant bug exists on diona/razor/shenhe/venti — see [[curator-notes-deferral-survey]].

Hold variant cooldownStartDelay is 89 frames (gcsim: skillCDStarts[1]=89); AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay field — OPEN schema gap (see [[curator-notes-deferral-survey]]; 12 chars affected). Hold CD-start delay under-renders by (89-14)/60 = 1.25s until that field lands.

C4 Sentinel Oath: reduces Hold cooldown from 9s to 6s (match Tap). gcsim skill.go: cd = skillCD[chargeLevel]; if Cons>=4 { cd = skillCD[0] } → skillCD={360,540}f = {6,9}s. Authored as cooldownModifiers flat -3 gated on constellation 4.

Hold shield override: same absorption as the base/Tap shield (21.6% Max HP + 2542.43 flat) but longer window — the barrier persists until the leaping strike lands (gcsim skillHitmarks[1]=91f → duration 1.52s), matching kit text 'This barrier lasts until the Elemental Skill is unleashed.'

Shield authored 2026-07-12 at talent level 10 (sidecar 'Shield DMG Absorption' row, 10th column '21.6% Max HP+2542'; gcsim candace_gen.go skillShieldPct[9]=0.216, skillShieldFlat[9]=2542.4312 → scaling 21.6% Max HP + 2542.43 flat). Same absorption for both Tap and Hold — gcsim skill.go adds the shield unconditionally (skillShieldPct*MaxHP + skillShieldFlat) regardless of chargeLevel; only the lifetime differs.

Shield is transient: it expires at the skill hitmark (gcsim skill.go: Expires = c.Core.F + hitmark). Tap hitmark = skillHitmarks[0] = 16f → duration 0.27s (base effects). Hold hitmark = skillHitmarks[1] = 91f → duration 1.52s (Hold variant effects override). A1 Aegis of Crossed Arrows (getting hit during Hold finishes the charge instantly, gcsim windup=55 → hitmark 36f) shortens the Hold window when it procs; not modeled.

Target 'self': gcsim Player.Shields.Add uses Target = c.Index() (Candace's own index) — this is Candace's personal guard shield during her cast, not a party shield that persists across swaps (unlike Thoma/Diona 'active' shields). Candace is on-field for the whole cast, so 'self' resolves correctly.
250% Hydro DMG Absorption Bonus not modeled (no per-element shield-efficiency primitive — same gap as Thoma Pyro / Diona Cryo shield notes).

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — — this is the exact case Nate named. Every elemental shield absorbs its own element at 250%, and the tool models no absorption for ANY shield (shields.ts: no HP or enemy state; a shield bar always runs its authored span). Nothing on screen looks wrong, and the fact is not specific to Candace. Category: general-game-knowledge.
abilities.description:
Candace's fighting style is capable of warding off an entire tide of foes.

Tap
Rushes forward with her shield, dealing Hydro DMG to opponents in front of her.

Hold
Raises her shield to block incoming attacks from nearby opponents, forming a barrier that absorbs DMG based on her Max HP and absorbs Hydro DMG 250% more effectively. This barrier lasts until the Elemental Skill is unleashed.
After holding for a certain period of time, Candace will finish charging, and when the skill button is released, the skill duration expires, or when the barrier is broken, she will perform a leaping strike that deals Hydro DMG to opponents in front of her.

abilities.name: Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide

durationModifiers.source: C1: Returning Heiress of the Scarlet Sands

_curatorNotes: Infuse + normalDmgBonus AUTHORED (capability sweep 2026-07-28): (a) hydro infusion — gcsim burst.go:91-97 AddWeaponInfuse(Hydro, Normal/Extra/Plunge) for Claymore/Spear/Sword on the active char, refreshed every 30f while 'candace-q' active (Bennett C6 is the weaponType-conditioned precedent); (b) +20% elemental Normal Attack DMG — gcsim burst.go:139 DmgP=0.2 HARDCODED (flat 20% at every talent level, not talent-scaled), burst.go:146-149 AttackTagNormal + non-Physical/NoElement only (caveated; the Stat union's normalDmgBonus is unscoped by element).

Duration 9s base per gcsim burst.go:54-57 (540f). C1 extends to 12s (720f) — EffectBase has no durationModifiers, so both effects stay at base 9s and the C1 extension is recorded here only (orchestrator call: no condition-twin duplicate effects); the summon lane already carries the C1 durationModifier.
Still unauthored: on-swap waves — up to 3 waves of hydro burst DMG triggered on character swap (gcsim burstSwap, waveCount capped at 3); no character-effect swap trigger primitive.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — The 9s "+20% Normal Attack DMG" received-buff bar (stat `normalDmgBonus`, target active), which the stat vocabulary cannot scope by element. It draws for whoever is on field — including a bow or catalyst holder, whose infusion the sibling `infuse` effect correctly withholds by `weaponType`, so every one of their normals is physical and gets none of it. The bar promises more than the game pays, and it draws beside the tinted normals that show the promise being kept for melee. Category: visible-divergence.
abilities.description:
Raising her weapon on high, Candace calls upon a divine blessing that deals AoE Hydro DMG based on her Max HP and continuously confers the Prayer of the Crimson Crown on your active character.

Prayer of the Crimson Crown
This effect has the following properties:
·Characters deal increased Elemental DMG with their Normal Attacks.
·Whenever a character takes the field, they will unleash a rippling wave of water that deals Hydro DMG to nearby opponents. There is a limited number of waves that can be triggered in the duration of this skill.
·Sword, Claymore, and Polearm-wielding characters under this effect will obtain a Hydro Infusion.

constellations.name: The Overflow
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual trigger — probable trigger: onHit with elemental normal attack (AttackTagNormal, element not Physical/NoElement) by the active non-Candace character while burst is active. gcsim cons.go c6: subscribes to OnEnemyDamage, checks active char != Candace, burstKey active, c6 ICD not active. ICD: 138 frames = 2.3s. Deals hydro burst DMG = 15% of Candace MaxHP. Reviewer to rewrite trigger and add procCooldown: 2.3.

↻ 2026-09-21 (manual-trigger retirement, docs/manual-trigger-retirement-round.md). C6: The Overflow — effects[0] (damage, 15% `hp`, hydro) RE-TRIGGERED and RE-HOMED onto the burst ability. ⚓ A proc is armed by the CAST that hosts it: `armCastProcs` (`sim/run.ts`) is handed `variant?.effects ?? active.effects` and never sees a constellation entry, so an effect authored here would be armed by nothing. The constellation gate travels with the effect's own `conditions` instead (the Faruzan C6 precedent). gcsim: `cons.go:34-78` — `OnEnemyDamage` gated on `AttackTagNormal` (cons.go:38), element not Physical/NoElement (cons.go:41), actor is the active character (cons.go:44), actor is not Candace (cons.go:47), `burstKey` active (cons.go:50) and a 138f ICD (cons.go:53). `ICDTagNone`, Durability 25, `FlatDmg = 0.15 × MaxHP`, hit at `waveHitmark = 1` (`burst.go:21`). The `burstKey` window is 540f, 720f at C1 (`burst.go:54-57`), started at `burstHitmark` = 33f (`burst.go:60-65`). `_curatorNotes` on the C6 entry must retain that the effect now lives on the burst because that is where its window is, and that `armedFor: 12.55` is `burstHitmark` 33f + the C1-extended 720f status — C6 implies C1, so the 12s form is the only one reachable at this gate (the Faruzan C6 "C6 implies C2" precedent). ⚠️ `source: "others"` is the exact reading of gcsim's two actor checks (active AND not Candace) — our normal-attack hits are by construction the active character's, so `'others'` adds only the not-Candace half, and it refuses entity-delivered hits. `damageType: "elemental"` depends on the parser resolving the burst's own granted Hydro infusion per swing (Radiance-window round), which is what makes a melee wielder's normals qualify; a bow/catalyst holder qualifies on their own element. `icdGate: "none"` is gcsim's `ICDTagNone` and must be authored — omission would mean "standard", which is wrong. The burst's other unauthored wave source (on-swap waves, `burstSwap`, capped at 3) is a different mechanic with no trigger and stays noted only.
constellations.description:
When characters (excluding Candace herself) affected by the Prayer of the Crimson Crown caused by Sacred Rite: Wagtail's Tide deal Elemental DMG to opponents using Normal Attacks, an attack wave will be unleashed that deals AoE Hydro DMG equal to 15% of Candace's Max HP.
This effect can trigger once every 2.3s and is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
